body:
OBSERVED, confirmed independently (Opus).

Authorization for Duplicates is admin-OR-edit on both the classic route
(`cps/duplicates.py:548-551`, `admin_or_edit_required`) and the SPA's own API
(`cps/api/duplicates.py:28-41`). Classic's sidebar matches it:
`cps/render_template.py:202` — `if current_user.role_admin() or current_user.role_edit()`.

The SPA sidebar instead gates on upload-or-admin:
`frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:334` — `(canUpload || isAdmin) && showDuplicates`.

`upload` and `edit` are distinct bits, so this is wrong in both directions:
- an EDIT-only user is authorized by the API but never shown the link;
- an UPLOAD-only user is shown a link whose API answers 403.

Fix: gate the sidebar entry on admin-or-edit to match the route and the API, and add
edit-only and upload-only cases to the role matrix the risk register calls for
(R13) — this finding is the concrete instance proving that matrix is not optional.
title: Duplicates sidebar link is gated on the wrong role bit, failing in both directions
